name: Trailing Stops
author: sirmenef
description: Buy-dip, buy-bounce and trailing sell-stop alerts (each with its own %) for any share on Google Finance, with a dropdown to manage tickers, optional phone push via ntfy and optional AI-written, fact-checked alert analysis and daily roundup

barWidget.description: Icon that opens a panel of tracked shares; red when a sell stop fires, green when a buy alert fires
